items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Teo Macero was pointing out the music. I remember him pointing the music to Miles as he played. That’s why I know I was on that session.

ctx.x: Because he was also on – he’s coming up on a Gil Evans date that you were on too.

I know Gil Evans. I played – I recorded - I think Miles was on that, wasn’t it? I did one. Teo Macero was pointing out the music. I remember him pointing the music to Miles as he played. That’s why I know I was on that session. That was kind of funny, because he kept trying to help Miles stay in the right place by pointing to the music.
